name: Script Picker - Open Card
purpose: Opens the Script Picker card window. Clears the chosen script variables; with no file name it first sets the file list (script 377) and opens the card, otherwise it opens the card and goes straight to the script list for that file.
open_question: Generator tooling; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product.

name: Script Picker - Save Card
purpose: Closes the Script Picker card and stores the chosen script name and id as JSON in $$SelectedScript for the caller.
open_question: Generator tooling; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product.

name: Script Picker - Handle Click
purpose: Handles a click in the Script Picker. For the Script list it loads the scripts of the chosen file (script 376) and shows the Script panel; otherwise it clears the script list and shows the File panel.
open_question: Generator tooling; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product.
